item.title: 🌈🐟 First Automated Dot — Three Cards on the Open Web
item.description:
🚂 ALL ABOARD! Our first Dotland experiment features three cards: The First Auto Dot (White), On the Open Web (Blue), and Pixel (Red).

Little Pixel is exploring a colorful open web. 🌈 ❤️ 💚 💙 And yes, a little fish is along for the ride! 🐟

Read the public Markdown collection or visit the three-card gallery.

This is an open-web interoperability experiment. The RSS announcement links to the original publication and the live FanVault destination.
